projects.title: LiveBulletin
projects.description: Virtual bulletin board to organize messages, events, and announcements
projects.details: Most everyone has seen a bulletin board of some fashion. If you attend a church they might have a list of events and announcements posted. I set out to create a simple virtual solution to help everyone get connected and stay informed. The app allows businesses to invite team members, create events, and share announcements. It features team collaboration, configurable security access, and mobile-friendly design.
highlights: Deployed to Azure using web containers

projects.title: Generative AI Dynamic Web Page Generator
projects.description: Using AI to create content and designs
projects.details: To deepen understanding of AI, I developed a project to generate web pages based on a prompt. Instead of having AI generate raw HTML, I fed into the AI model sections that represented HTML code. Each section defined what it was and what inputs were needed. I then allowed the model to choose the best sections and generate inputs for each section. This proof of concept demonstrates the power of structured AI prompting.
highlights: Proof of concept for AI-driven design

projects.title: Team Reporting Tool
projects.details: I developed this tool to promote healthy teams in the workplace. I developed both a fully functional website and iOS and Android app. The tool allows a business to invite team members. Team members can then be assigned a leader. Every week team members fill out a report asking simple questions, such as their high and low of the week and allows them to rate their stress, morale, and workload. Users can customize the report to add their own questions and ratings.

projects.title: AI/ML Support Ticket Urgency Predictor
projects.description: Using AI & ML to predict urgency
projects.details: For my WGU capstone project I wrote a website that would use machine learning and AI to predict the urgency level of support tickets. The goal was that given a set of data that contains support tickets that have been labeled as urgent/not urgent on a scale of 0-3, the computer would be able to predict the urgency of a new support ticket. The project resulted in an accuracy result of 85.82%.

projects.title: Musicians Worship
projects.details: In my spare time, I worked on a personal project that combined my passion for music and software development. I aimed to create a website to manage chord charts and resources for songs, and to establish a community for sharing these resources with the world. The site included features such as sending friend requests, creating groups for sharing ideas, adding songs, creating playlists, and other tools useful for church musicians. In one version, I even added a real-time instant messenger for users to communicate. The search included simplistic search correction to offer 'did you mean' functionality. I rewrote the project 2-3 times to improve the code, and initially started in Angular.JS before rewriting the frontend in Angular.

projects.title: Penguin Jump
projects.details: In my spare time, I developed an infinite runner game called 'Penguin Jump'. This engaging game features a variety of power-ups and sound effects to enhance the player experience. Additionally, the app includes a store where players can use the coins they collect to purchase new skins for the penguin. The artwork for the penguin character was drawn by my sister, and I digitized it. The development process allowed me to hone my skills in game design and programming.

projects.title: AI Helpdesk Ticket Summarizer
projects.details: I built a tool at work to help our team — especially the developers — get the gist of helpdesk tickets at a glance and act accordingly. By pulling out critical details from each ticket, it saves our team the time of digging for context and key info. Nearly all of the code was generated via Copilot, but I approached the project as if I were writing it myself—debugging, testing, and refining each piece individually before assembling everything into a working solution. The tool looks for tasks in ClickUp that have a helpdesk ticket link but do not yet have a summary comment. Because the helpdesk system is outdated and lacks an API, the solution fakes a login via POST requests and manages cookies to retrieve ticket detail pages. Once it has the ticket data, it uses OpenAI to generate a concise summary and adds that as a comment in ClickUp.

projects.title: Sales Tracker - Blazor Hybrid
projects.details: I developed a demo Sales Tracker and Inventory Management System to explore Blazor Hybrid and better understand how to share UI and business logic across native and web platforms. The application follows an offline-first approach and runs on desktop, mobile, and in the browser from a largely shared codebase. It includes a dashboard with monthly sales metrics, profit calculations, pending deliveries, and backorder detection. Users can create and manage sales with real-time inventory validation, automatic stock allocation, and item management with image uploads.
highlights: Clean architecture and separation of concerns
